title: Property tree for tree_from_json
description: A request or offer tree as delivered by upstream extraction (HLD §3.2, §11.8). tree_from_json(json, tree_id, lang, unit_table) turns it into tree_nodes and tree_attributes rows. A bare node object (without the envelope) is accepted as the root.

tree_id.description: Defaults to the root's node_id; the tree_id argument overrides it.

source.description: Source system or document family; inherited by every node (used for per-source centring).

lang.description: Language of the texts ('en', 'de' or a list, first entry decides ambiguous number separators). The lang argument overrides it.

role.description: Default role of every attribute, e.g. 'required' or 'provided'.

node_id.description: Unique within the tree. Numbers keep their digits as written.

kind.description: Lower-cased. Default: container when the node has children, item otherwise.

edge.description: Edge to the parent: AND composes, OR is an alternative. Default AND.

class_id.description: Reviewed or known class; otherwise resolved later (vocabulary, classifier).

count.description: Extensive multiplicity, default 1. Counts multiply along the path.

source.description: Overrides the document's source for this node.

attr_id.description: Unique within the node; missing ids become a1, a2, ... skipping ids in use.

text.description: The value as written. Parsed with parse_quantity when no lo/hi are given; its bound is used when bound is missing or null.

lo.description: In the given unit; converted to the base unit.

unit.description: Customer unit as written (mm, cm, mA, °C, EUR ...). Unknown units keep the number and give dimension NULL.

category.description: Ordinal or categorical value (e.g. IP54) instead of lo/hi.
